pair.title: Connect Sugar Sense
pair.description:
Scan the QR code with your phone, or open **[{label}]({url})** and enter this code:

## {code}

Sign in with your Sugar Sense account and tap **Connect**. Then press **Submit** here.

Home Assistant shows and automates. It never replaces your alerts. Alerts stay on your phone.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Sugar Sense
reauth_confirm.description: This Home Assistant was disconnected from your Sugar Sense account. Connect it again with a new code.

progress.waiting:
Waiting for you to connect.

Open **{label}**, enter the code **{code}** and tap **Connect**. This closes by itself.

error.code_expired: That code expired before it was used. Here is a new one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Sugar Sense. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.disabled: Connecting Home Assistant is paused on the Sugar Sense side. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Sugar Sense account is already connected to this Home Assistant.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Sugar Sense. Check the internet connection and try again.
abort.disabled: Connecting Home Assistant is paused on the Sugar Sense side. Try again later.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Sugar Sense account. Reconnect with the account that was connected before, or remove this integration and add it again.

premium_required.title: Sugar Sense Premium is needed
premium_required.description: {account} is connected, but showing glucose in Home Assistant is part of Sugar Sense Premium. Start Premium in the Sugar Sense app and the readings appear here by themselves within a few minutes.

no_source.title: No glucose source in Sugar Sense yet
no_source.description: {account} is connected, but the account has no glucose source yet. Open the Sugar Sense app and connect your sensor. The readings appear here by themselves.

follower_only.title: This Sugar Sense account follows someone else
follower_only.description: {account} is connected, but it has no glucose of its own: it follows another person. This version shows the connected account's own readings only. Connect the account of the person who wears the sensor.
